notes.title: Release of "With Eyes Closed" and French Localization of "Going Rogue"
notes.notes:
Exciting news! "Going Rogue" has been localized into French, thanks to the incredible work of Tomberaid.

In addition, my new game "With Eyes Closed" is now available. If you enjoyed "Going Rogue," you definitely don't want to miss this one! 😉

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492780/With_Eyes_Closed__Season_1/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492780/With_Eyes_Closed__Season_1/[/url]

notes.title: With Eyes Closed game's Steam page is now live!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=NS-cNjiG17A;full][/previewyoutube]
I want to share some news: my next game now has a page on Steam.
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492780/With_Eyes_Closed__Season_1/]With Eyes Closed - Season 1[/url][/b] is a thriller in the adult visual novel genre. It focuses on storytelling, realistic characters, and lets players control the story's development. The game also features plenty of hot scenes interwoven into the storyline. 
It should particularly appeal to those who prioritize plot in visual novels and those who enjoyed Going Rogue. In With Eyes Closed, I apply all the best practices I learned during the development of Going Rogue and strive to avoid its shortcomings.
The release date is scheduled for the first half of 2024. [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492780/With_Eyes_Closed__Season_1/]Add it to your wishlists so you don't miss out.[/url][/b]

notes.title: Localization of the game in Russian and Chinese. Revision of the English version
notes.notes:
I am thrilled to announce that "Going Rogue" is now localized into Chinese and Russian, expanding its reach to a larger global audience.
And this is not a fan translation, but a full-fledged localization, carried out by professional translation studios, which were able to ensure the localization process was conducted flawlessly, preserving the unique allure and immersive nature of my game in these new languages.

Further to this exciting news, I am delighted to share that the original English version of "Going Rogue" has undergone a thorough revision for an improved gameplay experience. I've had the incredible opportunity to work with a professional American editor to fine-tune and perfect the game's language. 

This update includes refining the game text for clarity, enhancing the narrative flow, and ensuring that the humor, cultural references, and overall atmosphere of the game are accurately conveyed. I'm sure that with this update, English-speaking players will find their journey through Going Rogue even more exciting.

I am immensely grateful for your continued support and love for Going Rogue. As always, your feedback is important to me. Please let me know your thoughts on the new language updates. I'm looking forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: In-Game Walkthrough ready
notes.notes:
I made a Game Walkthrough mode. It is available for those who bought the DLC. 
You can turn it on in the settings or when starting a new game.
I hope you enjoy it. If you find bugs, or on the contrary, everything works well, please let me know.

notes.title: Controller support was added.
notes.notes: The entire game can now be played using the controller. The only time you'll need a keyboard is when entering your character's name. Everything else is adjusted, including the QTE events.

notes.title: Skip and Auto buttons
notes.notes:
Added Skip and Auto buttons to the bottom left corner of UI. 
There was feedback from some players that the game does not allow you to skip text. Skip was always there, but you had to press Tab to activate it. This is a standard button for most VN, but some players are more accustomed to having this button on the screen.
There was also a request to add the ability to auto-forward text. Added.
